messages:
sara_fin: Heads-up: Kestrel Labs INV-2029-078 ($42,300) bounced (ACH R03) on 2024-03-18. AP cites PO mismatch. Soft dunning went out yesterday. Options: schedule retries, send pay link, offer split payment, or escalate.

billing-bot: Soft dunning email delivered to billing@kestrel.com at 2235556791. Next automated ACH retry scheduled in 48h.

eli_sales: AE reports Kestrels AP will wire once they have a PO. They're asking for a signed addendum to allow split payments. Can we permit a 50/50 with a signed addendum?

tom_ops: I can queue two more ACH retries (48h apart) and generate a one-time pay link. Sample command we use:
```
/billing create-link INV-2029-078 amount=42300 expire_days=7
```

sara_fin: Do it: queue retries and create a 7-day pay link. If still unpaid after 7 days, add 10% late fee and escalate. Waiting on legal for the timeline.

maria_legal: Reminder: SOW section 4.2 requires a 30-day cure notice before external collections. Recommend sending a formal notice quoting that clause, cc legal, and allow 14 days for internal escalation before third-party collections. Also: if they claim a usage dispute, do not withhold undisputed amounts; capture disputes in writing.

michelle_csr: Drafting the formal notice. Will attach invoice PDF, ledger export, pay link, and wire instructions. Will post a copy here when sent.

eli_sales: If they sign 50/50 and pay the first installment, sales will keep product access live and help procurement get the PO sorted.

sara_fin: Plan agreed: 1) queue ACH retries, 2) create/send pay link, 3) send formal notice cc:legal, 4) escalate to collections after internal 14-day window post-notice (subject to SOW). Michelle please attach invoice & ledger when sending.

billing-bot: Payment link created: https://pay.redwood.example/lnk/unique456 (expires in 7 days).

michelle_csr: Formal notice sent at 2235557900 to billing@kestrel.com and legal@kestrel.com. Subject: "Formal Notice: Past Due INV-2029-078 per SOW 4.2". Included SOW excerpt and payment options. Excerpt: "Per SOW 4.2, customer shall cure payment within thirty (30) days of invoice receipt. Failure to cure may result in interest and collections."

sara_fin: Logged ticket ESCALATE-INV-2029-078. I'll review status at 2235558200 and decide next step. :thumbsup:
